The official archive tool of /v/archivism is wpull.

The official preffered archive format is warc, mostly because with websites preserved this way header information is preserved as well. This means, for example, that one could find all the dead links on a site from spotting all the 404 errors.

The official online warc viewer of /v/archivism is https://webrecorder.io/.

The official offline warc viewer of /v/archivism is webarchiveplayer, but also see warc-proxy.

Also see the the other warc-related tools.
